scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build:helper: swiftc -O -o resources/ClipStackHelper native/ClipStackHelper.swift && bash scripts/wrap-helper-app.sh resources/ClipStackHelper build/icon.icns && swiftc -O -o resources/DisclaimSpawner native/DisclaimSpawner.swift
scripts.build:helper:universal: swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos11 -o /tmp/ClipStackHelper-arm64 native/ClipStackHelper.swift && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos11 -o /tmp/ClipStackHelper-x64 native/ClipStackHelper.swift && lipo -create -output resources/ClipStackHelper /tmp/ClipStackHelper-arm64 /tmp/ClipStackHelper-x64 && rm /tmp/ClipStackHelper-arm64 /tmp/ClipStackHelper-x64 && bash scripts/wrap-helper-app.sh resources/ClipStackHelper build/icon.icns && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos11 -o /tmp/DisclaimSpawner-arm64 native/DisclaimSpawner.swift && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos11 -o /tmp/DisclaimSpawner-x64 native/DisclaimSpawner.swift && lipo -create -output resources/DisclaimSpawner /tmp/DisclaimSpawner-arm64 /tmp/DisclaimSpawner-x64 && rm /tmp/DisclaimSpawner-arm64 /tmp/DisclaimSpawner-x64
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:helper && electron-vite build
scripts.build:mac: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run typecheck && npm run build:helper:universal && electron-vite build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac && bash scripts/gen-latest-json.sh
scripts.build:mac:arm64: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run typecheck && npm run build:helper && electron-vite build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 && bash scripts/gen-latest-json.sh
scripts.build:mac:x64: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run typecheck && npm run build:helper:universal && electron-vite build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --x64 && bash scripts/gen-latest-json.sh
